dsa_problems.title: Two Sum
dsa_problems.notes: Solved using Hash Map in O(n) time and O(n) space.

dsa_problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
dsa_problems.notes: Track minimum price so far and calculate max profit.

dsa_problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
dsa_problems.notes: Sliding window with character index hash map.

dsa_problems.title: 3Sum
dsa_problems.notes: Sort array + two-pointer approach, avoid duplicate triplets.

dsa_problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
dsa_problems.notes: Need to review two-pointer vs monotonic stack approach.

dsa_problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
dsa_problems.notes: Dummy head node simplifies pointer reassignment.

dsa_problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
dsa_problems.notes: Simple recursive post-order DFS: 1 + max(left, right).

dsa_problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
dsa_problems.notes: Leverage BST property: if both values are greater, go right, else left.

dsa_problems.title: Number of Islands
dsa_problems.notes: Grid traversal with DFS or BFS marking visited cells as '0'.

dsa_problems.title: Course Schedule (Cycle Detection)
dsa_problems.notes: Kahn's Topological Sort algorithm using indegree array.

dsa_problems.title: Coin Change
dsa_problems.notes: Unbounded knapsack style DP bottom-up 1D array.

dsa_problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
dsa_problems.notes: O(n^2) dp or O(n log n) with patience sorting / binary search.

dsa_problems.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
dsa_problems.notes: Binary search on partition points of smaller array in O(log(min(m, n))).
